summary: Iteration 20 — Collections (net-new): backend CRUD + 2 screens + Home quick-action route change. VERDICT: ALL PASS, ZERO REGRESSIONS. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests green (test_iteration20_collections.py) covering POST/GET-list/GET-detail(404)/PATCH(add,remove,idempotent-addToSet,rename,404)/DELETE and the outfit-delete → collections.$pull tidy behaviour. Response shapes match spec: list items expose {id,name,count,cover:[{photo,category}]}, detail exposes {outfits:[…resolved with items], outfit_ids, count, cover}, PATCH returns the resolved detail. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport, seeded bearer test-session-token-aura-123 for user_testaura01): home-qa-collections + the other three quick actions (add / create / stylist) all visible; tapping My Collections routes to /collections (regression fix confirmed — was /(tabs)/outfits). On /collections the empty state renders correctly (folder icon + 'No collections yet' + 'Create Collection' CTA testID collections-empty-create). The + top-bar icon (collections-add) opens the New-collection modal with collection-name-input; typing a name + tapping collection-create-confirm POSTs and navigates to /collection/<new_id>. On the detail screen collection-back, collection-add-outfits (sage CTA) and collection-menu (trash) are all present. 'Add outfits' opens a bottom-sheet listing all 5 saved outfits with add-outfit-<id> rows; tapping toggles PATCH add_outfit/remove_outfit correctly (verified two toggles → detail now shows exactly 2 coll-outfit-<id> cards). Tapping a coll-outfit-<id> tile navigates to /outfit/<id>. Console shows only the pre-existing app-wide RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) — NOT caused by this iteration. /planner still loads (regression sample) with 'The week ahead' + today card + 6 'Plan this day' rows — no red screen.
critical_code_review_comments: collection/[id].tsx delete flow uses Alert.alert with a destructive option — this works natively on iOS/Android but on RN-Web the destructive callback does not fire (Alert.alert falls back to window.alert which has only OK). Not blocking (target platform is mobile) but flag if a web build is ever shipped: swap for an in-app confirm modal for web parity.

Backend _resolve_collection scans up to 500 items for every collection on GET /collections — fine at current scale, but if a user grows past hundreds of items+collections consider caching items_by_id once per request instead of per-collection.
seed_data_creation: One temporary collection (TEST_UI_Coll) created via UI and cleaned up post-test; pytest suite created and deleted TEST_* collections in fixtures + a TEST_OutfitForCollDel outfit which was deleted as part of the pull-from-collection assertion. All test data cleaned up — no residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Collections is stable. Test seed: mobile viewport 390x844, localStorage.setItem('aura_session_token', JSON.stringify('test-session-token-aura-123')) + same key with '@AsyncStorage:' prefix, then GET /. testIDs on this feature: home-qa-collections (Home QA), collections-back / collections-add / collections-empty-create / collection-<id> / collection-name-input / collection-create-confirm (list + modal), collection-back / collection-menu / collection-add-outfits / coll-outfit-<id> / add-outfit-<id> (detail + sheet). Delete-confirm modal is a native RN Alert — on web the destructive branch never fires; verify delete via native build or by direct DELETE /api/collections/<id>. user_testaura01 currently has 5 saved outfits available in the Add-outfits sheet.
